STEP 1, and you must do this first: decide whether the image is a government-issued identity document -- a passport, national ID card, residence or Emirates ID, or a driving licence. If it is ANYTHING else -- a greeting card, a photograph, a screenshot, a poster, religious or decorative imagery, a vehicle, a receipt, a meme -- then set isIdentityDocument to false, set every other field to null, and STOP. Do not describe the picture in documentType. Do not guess a name. Do not assign a confidence score to something that is not a document. STEP 2, only if it IS an identity document: extract Full Name, Date of Birth, Expiry Date, Document Type and Validity, and check for tampering or inconsistencies. Respond STRICTLY in JSON format: { "isIdentityDocument": true/false, "fullName": "...", "dateOfBirth": "...", "expiryDate": "...", "documentType": "...", "isValid": true/false, "tamperingDetected": true/false, "confidenceScore": 0-100, "remarks": "..." }' }, { role: 'user', content: $json.hasImage ? [ { type: 'text', text: 'Is this a government-issued identity document? If so, audit it. If not, set isIdentityDocument false and stop.' }, { type: 'image_url', image_url: { url: 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' + $json.imageBase64 } } ] : ('Analyze this KYC document text:\n\n' + $json.documentContent) } ] }) }}

nodes.name: Record Non-Document
nodes.notes: verdict must be one of PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED/ESCALATED -- kyc_documents_verdict_check. It used to write 'NOT_A_DOCUMENT' there, which 400'd, and because this node both swallows its errors and is terminal, the row silently never existed while the image sat in Storage. The classification now lives in document_type, which is free text.
